title: RupeeBias: Auditing Demographic Bias in Indian Economic Guidance from Large Language Models

bias_targets.methodology: Counterfactual substitution of caste identifiers (e.g., Brahmin, Dalit, OBC) in prompts for economic recommendations like salary estimation, salary increments, and service pricing, while holding user qualifications constant.
